summary.en: A question typed in a terminal is answered by counting: sources pop in as pills, the window grows, a field of cells fills one column at a time and a bar fills, each figure landing with a hop.
summary.zh: 在终端里打出的问题用计数回答：来源以药丸弹出，窗口长高，小格一列列填满、进度条填满，每个数字落定时跳一下。

fits: Opening a film on a question and its scale.
notFor: Answers that are not counts; more than two figures.

intent.en: Hook the viewer with a plain question and a number big enough to need explaining.
intent.zh: 用一个朴素的问题和一个大到需要解释的数字抓住观众。

content.en: A question (≤ 40 / 18), up to three source pills (≤ 12 / 4), one or two counts (label ≤ 26 / 12, value, optional "nearly" prefix), a note.
content.zh: 一个问题（≤ 40 / 18）、至多 3 个来源（≤ 12 / 4）、一到两个计数（标签 ≤ 26 / 12、数值、可选“近”）、一条注。

fits.zh: 用一个问题和它的规模开场。

notFor.zh: 答案不是计数；超过两个数字。

pairs.note: next: the window shrinks into the wall

en: The question must be readable while it types: 0.055 s a grapheme, then hold.
The cells are one item each; say so in the note.
zh: 问题要边打边能读：每字 0.055 秒，打完停住。
一格一件事，在注里写明。

source.path: the source film 0–9.7 s; skills/teach-video/assets/kits/terminal-ledger/starter/components/term.js, grid.js, counter.js

waive.all: an own brick split from teach-video's terminal-ledger kit: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the kit's approved example film at the same moments (the style's recipe, card: Differs from upstream)
